svg.title: workstation-steward: keep your config in a private Git repo
svg.desc: An illustrative session, looping, in four scenes. It turns ~/.config/workstation-steward into a Git repository and pushes it to a new private GitHub repository with gh; clones it on another Mac, checks it with steward check and points mise at it with steward sc link; on the first Mac, an upgrade changes mise/mise.lock, which is committed and pushed; on the other Macs, git pull brings the change and mise install applies it.

text.tspan: git init -b main && git add -A && git commit -m 'My steward config'
# 3. day to day: a change on this Mac
